item.text: [{"task_id":"782b5218","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    barrier = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    direction = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    colors = [int(c) for c in np.unique(grid) if int(c) != background and int(c) != barrier]","    fill = colors[0] if colors else background","    result = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    coordinates = np.arange(grid.shape[0]) * direction","    for column in range(grid.shape[1]):","        boundary = grid[:, column] == barrier","        if np.any(boundary):","            edge = np.max(coordinates[boundary])","            result[:, column] = np.where(coordinates > edge, fill, background)","            result[boundary, column] = barrier","    return result"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,2,1]},"rationale":"Preserve the red boundary and replace each column below its lowest red cell with the input's other nonbackground color.
